title: Optical mouse
prompt: an optical computer mouse on a desk: slide the mouse, compare the camera's pictures, click the button and lift the mouse off the desk; see-through shows the red LED, lens, tiny camera sensor, chip, click switch and scroll wheel
blurb: A red LED lights the desk at a low angle, a tiny camera takes thousands of pictures a second, and a chip works out how far each picture has shifted to move the cursor.
